title: Why You Should NOT Drive If Your License Is Revoked
description:
On March 27, 2022, police responded to a two-vehicle car accident with injuries in La Crosse, WI. A vehicle was struck by another after running a red light. When both were transported to the hospital, officers consulted with each driver. The driver of the striking vehicle happened to have a revoked license and an officer advised that he would be taken into custody upon being medically cleared. Hours later, the man fled the hospital.
